evals.prompt: Add beginner-friendly educational comments to src/main.py.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates educational-commenting workflow, classifies Python as supported, uses Python comment syntax, and validates statically when safe.

evals.prompt: Annotate this TSX component with inline notes for someone learning React.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates, applies JS/TS repository instructions, avoids JSX syntax hazards, and uses note numbering if configured.

evals.prompt: Review the comments in this file and tell me which are stale.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not add educational comments automatically; performs comment-quality review or asks whether edits are desired.
Does not inject inline educational comments; treats as documentation task.

evals.prompt: Add comments directly to package.json explaining each field.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates only to refuse direct JSON commenting and offers sidecar notes.

evals.prompt: Add educational comments to .env explaining each variable.
evals.expected_behavior: Refuses direct edit of secret-bearing file and requests redacted input or sidecar general notes.
